about: MasterCraft Boat Holdings, Inc., through its subsidiaries, designs, manufactures, and markets recreational powerboats. It operates through Performance and Wake, Leisure, and Recreation and Sport Fishing segments. The Performance and Wake Segment manufactures and sells ski/wake boats used for water skiing, wakeboarding, wake surfing, and general recreational boating under the MasterCraft brand name. The Leisure segment manufactures and sells pontoon boats used for general recreational boating under the Crest and Balise brand names. Recreation and Sport Fishing Segment provides manufactures and sells recreational fiberglass powerboats for both the pleasure boating and sport fishing markets under the Chaparral and Robalo brand names. It also provides trailers, marine parts, aftermarket parts, and accessories. The company sells products through a network of independent dealers in the United States and internationally. The company was formerly known as MCBC Holdings, Inc. and changed its name to MasterCraft Boat Holdings, Inc. in November 2018. MasterCraft Boat Holdings, Inc. was founded in 1968 and is headquartered in Vonore, Tennessee.
